items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Well, Walter was playing with him the time he died and I was playing with him when he died. He was playing with him in his band.

ctx.x: Yeah. The blues, he could play blues too. Did that guitar player or bass or something? Yeah, he had a guitar player.

Used to use this boy, let's see what his name is. Used to live on San Francisco's feet. He's dead too. He used to use Walter Preston a good bit too in his band. You know Walter? I didn't know him. I've heard of him. Well, Walter was playing with him the time he died and I was playing with him when he died. He was playing with him in his band. What kind of jobs did you get mostly with Chris Kelly? You were in the dance hall? Dance hall. Yeah, people used to give plenty dances. You know? Big dance hall. See that…
Just always a small band, was it about six or seven or how many? He used seven pieces in his band. Yeah.
